title: Atrinik
description: Atrinik is an open-source role-playing world under human creative direction, with primarily Codex-driven software development and human code contributions welcome.

privacy.providerEdgeDisclosure: Cloudflare may inject bot/security JavaScript or a dashboard-managed Web Analytics beacon, set strictly necessary cookies, or serve a challenge with its own HTML, scripts, cookies, and CSP. The ordinary page's no-script CSP blocks injected scripts.

identity.heading: Human creativity at the heart of the world. Agent-driven software beneath it.
identity.gameContent: Human creators direct Atrinik's game world. Generated visual and audio assets are not accepted as final content; clearly identified temporary design drop-ins may be used until human-created replacements are found or made. For maps, quests, dialogue, and lore, generative tools may help a content creator shape terrain or develop writing; the creator directs and reviews the result. Repository owners are auditing the existing corpus before making a blanket authorship claim.
identity.software: Software is developed primarily through Codex-driven agentic workflows under human direction, review, provenance, and validation. Direct human code contributions are welcome under the same gates.
identity.websiteMediaException: The four generated website concept images are not game content. They remain explicitly recorded and credited as temporary design drop-ins while suitable human-created replacements are found or made.
